name: humanpost
description: Create social content drafts, queue approved posts, and track publishing with HumanPost.

interface.longDescription: Connect AI assistants to one HumanPost company to inspect accounts, prepare drafts, queue approved content, and track human posting and analytics. Sign in to HumanPost and choose the company and permissions. Connections can be revoked in Settings → API Keys. Write actions can consume credits or publish content; perform them only when requested.
defaultPrompt: Show my HumanPost social accounts and posting queues.
Prepare a HumanPost draft for my review.
